author: GamingBolt
description:
Saying Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown is launching at an awkward time would be an understatement. Whether you're exploring the Wulin in Phantom Blade Zero and getting humbled by its many bosses (or taking them to town – either is certainly possible), waiting to revisit Vice City after decades or crossing into Hyrule Field in all its remade glory, this may be one of the unluckier release windows for an expansion.

Which is a shame because from the few hours that we managed to squeeze in, this is exactly what the base game needed.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown Is a Blast, Until It Gets in Its Own Way

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown has finally opened up the shores of Pywel to Kliff and his comrades, and we’ve been having a blast sailing around the high seas. Of course, we made mistakes so you don’t have to, and we've come up with a bunch of useful tips and tricks to help you have an easier time in the expansion’s early hours.

Of course, making some of these suggestions muscle memory is going to be useful in maintaining an efficient flow of important resources, materials, and upgrades for you to make use of while you explore to your heart’s content. It’s time to tame the wild oceans of Pywel, and you’re perfectly suited to the task as long as you are smart about how you go about it.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown - 15 Beginner Tips That Make a HUGE Difference
